reason: R8 means nothing to me, but I don't plan ahead. Our group decides in the WhatsApp chat on the night and we pay at the door or on whatever platform the event already uses, so I'm not downloading a new app for that.
objection: Another app that does what I already do. If the comedy show or event is already on the platforms I use, why would I move over? I only would if TROVE had stuff I can't find anywhere else.
would_change_my_mind: If one of the guys drops a TROVE link in the group chat for something good happening tonight that we can't book anywhere else, and I can book all eight of us in a minute without making an account.
